title: LFU cache
summary: Build a least-frequently-used cache with O(1) get and put from frequency buckets, breaking ties by recency.
hints: A heap keyed on frequency gives O(log n), not O(1). Notice that a key's count only ever goes up by exactly one, so it only ever moves to the next bucket.
Keep three things: key → (value, freq), freq → an insertion-ordered set of keys (oldest first), and min_freq, the smallest freq that currently has a bucket.

On a hit, move the key from bucket f to bucket f + 1; if bucket f is now empty and f was min_freq, min_freq becomes f + 1. On inserting a new key into a full cache, evict the oldest key in bucket min_freq, then insert with freq 1 and set min_freq = 1.
